0022600171.text: The LA Clippers (1-5, 0-4 on the road) host the Toronto Raptors (3-3) in the Clippers' seventh game of the season, and they enter on a five-game losing streak, sitting 4th in the Pacific (3.5 games back) and 13th in the West. Toronto is on a two-game losing streak, sits 3rd in the Atlantic (2.5 games back) and 5th in the East, and has no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, though the Clippers won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 119-94 win in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026. For the Clippers, Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Derrick Jones Jr., Jordan Miller, Rui Hachimura and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are all out, while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle and Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with a game-time decision.
